title: A free literal under a bad restriction
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a disjunction of conjunctions of literals on $n$ coordinates, let $T$ be one of its terms, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate either free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. Suppose $T$ is compatible with $\rho$, meaning some assignment to the free coordinates makes every literal of $T$ hold after applying the restriction. Suppose also that the restricted function defined by $\varphi$ takes different values on two assignments to the free coordinates. Then $T$ contains a literal whose coordinate is free under $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
$\rho$ assigns each coordinate one of the three restriction states
The restricted function defined by $\varphi$ is nonconstant
